**7B.10 Research Note**
Kishida’s 2024 record is mixed but leans toward ethical-restoration behavior rather than normalized cynicism. The strongest positive evidence is repeated public acknowledgment of scandal, formal reform measures, and transparent succession. The strongest negative evidence is the faction-funding scandal around his party, plus damage-control politics and structural media friction. I found no reliable 2024 evidence of Kishida personally normalizing deliberate lying or self-dealing.

**Positive / Trust-Building**
- [Press Conference by Prime Minister Kishida](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202401/30shiseihoshin.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | January 30, 2024 | Kishida apologized over the LDP funding scandal, launched a Political Reform Headquarters, and promised transparency and legal reforms. This is direct evidence of modeling accountability after a trust-damaging scandal. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.9
- [Press Conference by Prime Minister Kishida](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202401/04kaiken2.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | January 4, 2024 | Kishida said the LDP would cooperate with prosecutors and invited external experts to design transparency rules for political funds. This supports a norm of outside scrutiny rather than impunity or concealment. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.9
- [Press Conference by Prime Minister Kishida](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202406/21kaiken.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | June 21, 2024 | Kishida said the Political Funds Control Act had been amended, disclosure thresholds were lowered, and a third-party inspections-and-audits body should be created. This is strong evidence of trying to normalize transparency and corrective oversight. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.9
- [Press Conference by Prime Minister Kishida](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202408/14kaiken.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | August 14, 2024 | Kishida said the LDP presidential race should be transparent, with free and vigorous debate, and that he would step aside and support the winner chosen by vote. This is direct evidence against sham-contest or self-entrenchment politics. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.9
- [Fact-Checking / Reliable Information Page](https://www.japan.go.jp/kizuna/2024/01/growing_importance_of_fact-checking.html) | JapanGov / Government of Japan | January 26, 2024 | The government quoted Kishida saying technologies that prove and confirm information origin should be developed and spread to promote reliable information distribution. This is a pro-truthfulness signal, not a propaganda signal. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8
- [Statement on AI Governance](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202405/02ai.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | May 2, 2024 | Kishida warned that generative AI can spread disinformation and called for safe, secure, trustworthy AI plus provenance verification. This supports a public posture that treats truth integrity as a governance duty. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8
- [2024 Democracy Summit Remarks](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202403/20message.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | March 20, 2024 | Kishida reaffirmed democracy and said Japan supported democratic elections abroad, including observer missions. This is indirect but real evidence of pro-democratic, pro-monitoring norms. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.9

**Negative / Cynicism**
- [Japan prosecutors make first arrest in political funding scandal](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Japan-prosecutors-make-first-arrest-in-political-funding-scandal-45687976/) | Reuters | January 7, 2024 | Prosecutors arrested a ruling-party lawmaker over undisclosed kickbacks and off-book money from faction fundraising events. This is negative evidence that Kishida’s governing party environment still contained hidden, scandalous finance. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.9
- [Update: prosecutors indict several LDP faction members over funds scandal](https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2024/01/f4d6ea5b7d8f-update1-prosecutors-indict-several-ldp-faction-members-over-funds-scandal.html) | Kyodo News | January 19, 2024 | Prosecutors indicted multiple ruling-party faction figures, including a former accountant from Kishida’s group, over roughly 500 million yen in undisclosed revenue. This is the clearest negative evidence that opaque factional money touched his orbit. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.9
- [Ethics-committee coverage](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/embattled-japan-pm-faces-ethics-committee-to-save-popularity-and-budget-3319362) | Reuters | February 28, 2024 | Reuters reported Kishida appeared before a parliamentary ethics committee, apologized, and said he would not host more fundraising parties during his term. This supports accountability, but it also shows the need for damage control and that trust had already been badly hurt. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7
- [AP legacy report](https://apnews.com/article/05926b50f4f5a83a631f779d906cf06d) | Associated Press | September 30, 2024 | AP said Kishida compromised with conservative nationalists to stay in power and that corruption scandals tied to LDP factions damaged his term. This is mixed evidence: survival bargaining can erode ethical credibility, though it is not proof of deliberate lying. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.9
- [Freedom House: Japan Freedom in the World 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/japan/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | Freedom House says Japan is generally open, but officials sometimes withhold information in scandal contexts and close government-business relations remain a concern. This is structural negative evidence for a fully trust-generating governing style. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.9
- [Freedom House: Japan Freedom on the Net 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/japan/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | Freedom House says government pressure and the kisha kurabu system contribute to self-censorship and restricted access. This does not show Kishida personally suppressing truth, but it weakens the claim that the information environment was fully trust-building. | QIDs: 7B.10, 7B.8, 7B.9

**Search Gap**
- I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Kishida personally lied in a documented, deliberate way.
- I found no reliable 2024 evidence of personal self-dealing by Kishida, such as personal enrichment or quid-pro-quo procurement.
- The negative side is mostly indirect: factional finance scandal, damage-control politics, and structural media/information frictions rather than direct authoritarian cynicism.
